scope: Existing Master/Binder viewing playback only; no new source identity or graph relation.

behaviour.default: Loop enabled, playback idle until explicit PLAY.
behaviour.wrap: RECORD stays visible for one existing master tick; wait for pending source acknowledgements; use existing source-owned Master restart, not a mathematical inverse.
behaviour.timers: At most one existing Master interval; existing Binder, M3 and Stack clocks stay separate.
behaviour.navigation: Loop suppresses phase auto-scroll; ordinary scrolling, background clicks and internal anchor navigation do not pause Master playback.
behaviour.interruption: Actual controls and explicit pause still interrupt. Hidden-document pause retained. Binder detects a paused nonterminal Master and stops its local companions.
excluded: manual Ihara C/D and reverse tests
behaviour.retention: Binder export includes completed master cycle count and last 16 Master phase-state snapshots; older cycles are not retained; not full source receipts or simultaneous snapshots.

verification.scope: Actual inline scheduler with real phase model and DOM/timer/source-side-effect doubles; 20 cycles, pending guard, one interval, bounded history, single pass, navigation vs control intervention, real Binder pause/finish/export.
verification.browser_visuals: OPEN; local browser access not bypassed

historical_boundary: r9 Binder pins and acceptance receipt remain historical for that revision. Known legacy M3/Mathfield pin conflicts are not repaired. No all-suite or whole-machine PASS.
